# Rival Poster Slot Assignment — historical batch note

This file records the original contact-sheet assignment pass that was used while the rival-poster system was being prototyped.

The canonical live import has now moved to **160 individually cropped PNGs** (`poster_001.png` … `poster_160.png`) plus the audited assignment catalog:

`src/engine/generated/rivalPosterCatalog.tsv`

For current runtime assignments, use:

`docs/rival-poster-import-map.csv`

For current capacity and live/pending state, use:

`src/engine/generated/rivalPosterManifest.json`

Current target:

- 28 slots per studio

Do not use this historical sheet note as the source of truth for runtime mapping.
